Where cultures collide & flavors unite

Tio's Latin American Kitchen Authentic Latin American & Mexican Restaurant · Hilton Head Island & Bluffton, SC

Traditional Mexican restaurant favorites and bold new fusions from Honduras, Cuba, Spain, Central and South America. Made fresh, served like family.

Authentic flavor

Traditional recipes. New fusions. One big table.

Tio's Latin American Kitchen is the Lowcountry's home for authentic Latin American cuisine. Our kitchen pulls from the whole map: street tacos and sizzling fajitas from Mexico, slow roasted pork from Cuba, banana leaf tamales from Honduras and saffron paella from Spain.

Salsa, queso and tortilla chips are made in house every day, and we hand squeeze our limes daily for every margarita. Find us on Hilton Head Island and in Bluffton, SC.

    Zuniga's Empanadas

    Fried turnovers stuffed with ground beef or chicken, with Tio's slaw, sofrito salsa and chipotle cream.

    Quesabirria Tacos

    Braised beef, melted cheese, onions and cilantro, served with consome for dipping.

    Cuban Roasted Pork Dinner

    Honduran Tamales

    Seasoned corn masa filled with adobo chicken, wrapped and steamed in a banana leaf.

    Fajitas

    Paella

Executive Chef

Chef Lynden Zunig, from Honduras to Hilton Head

Chef Lynden Zunig grew up in Honduras, Central America, and worked in kitchens through high school to pay rent. He quickly came to realize that making people happy with his food was his lifelong passion.

That passion is on every plate at Tio's, from the Honduran tamales he grew up on to the empanadas that carry his name.

Tio means uncle in Spanish. Pull up a chair.

Good to know

Questions before you visit

Where is Tio's Latin American Kitchen located?

Tio's has two Lowcountry locations: Shelter Cove Towne Centre at 40 Shelter Cove Ln #181, Hilton Head Island, SC 29928, and Buckwalter Place at 7 Venture Dr #106, Bluffton, SC 29910.

Does Tio's take reservations?

Yes. You can reserve a table online for either the Hilton Head Island or Bluffton location, or call Hilton Head at (843) 842-8467 or Bluffton at (843) 757-8467.

Can I order Tio's online for pickup?

Yes. Both the Hilton Head Island and Bluffton locations offer online ordering. Choose your location and order direct from the restaurant.

When is happy hour at Tio's?

Happy hour runs seven days a week from 4 PM to 6 PM at both locations, with drink specials and discounted bar snacks.

Does Tio's have gluten free, vegetarian and vegan options?

Yes. The menu marks gluten free, vegetarian and vegan dishes, including a Vegan Dinner, vegetable fajitas and a vegetable burrito. Tio's uses a separate fryer for gluten free items, but the kitchen does handle gluten, so please tell your server about any allergies.

Is Tio's kid friendly?

Very. Tio's has a kids menu for ages 10 and under that includes two sides and a fountain drink, plus an activity sheet at the table.
